messages:
elaine: Quick UX check — I pushed a small update to the Private setup wizard's Network step: added inline troubleshooting hints and a collapsible diagnostic panel. Screenshot attached in the thread (not in this export). Thoughts on copy and affordances?

samir: Skimmed it. Two quick asks: make the 'Run quick check' button lower-emphasis (secondary) so it doesn't compete with primary 'Continue' and remove the heavy blue around the diagnostic panel by default.

matt: +1 on the visual weight. Also the CIDR validation text is too jargon-y. Maybe: "Enter a network in CIDR form (eg `10.0.0.0/16`) or leave blank to use the default private range." Short, actionable.

keisha: A11y notes from the lab: when the network probe completes we should 1) populate a concise status summary and move focus to it, 2) announce status via aria-live (polite for passive info, assertive for failures), and 3) avoid focus traps inside the collapsed details.

elaine: Good catches. For failure copy I'm proposing: "Connection check failed. Open outbound port 443 to api.redwood.ai or run the diagnostic below for guidance." Thoughts on tone? Less scary, more prescriptive.

samir: Tone is good. Add a tiny KB link: "What ports does Redwood need?" — goes to docs. Also recommend adding a one-click 'Copy diagnostic command' for SREs (copy-to-clipboard).

matt: UX nit — collapse the logs by default, show a one-line summary with status pill (green/yellow/red) and a chevron that expands the console. Keep the action buttons visible when expanded.

keisha: Also keyboard behavior: ESC should close expanded details and return focus to the summary button. In the modal flow, ensure ESC closes the modal and focus returns to the same wizard step control that opened it. Document this in the a11y checklist.

elaine: For the diagnostic panel I'll include a tiny snippet and a copy button. Proposed snippet: ```
curl -sS https://diagnostics.redwood.ai/check?host=api.redwood.ai
```
(we'll mask any tokens server-side).

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @samir for branch feature/wizard-inline-hints — CI passed.

matt: Small experimentation idea: run an A/B where variant A shows the expanded diagnostic inline, variant B keeps it collapsed with 'Show details'. Measure completion rate and time-to-success.

keisha: Agree on the A/B. Also confirm screen reader users can access the diagnostics via a visible link and via a skip link so it's not lost in the noise.

elaine: I'll update the mock (copy + focus behavior + collapse state) and post annotated screenshots by EOD. If we all +1 I'll assign to eng for a quick roll (feature flagged).

samir: +1 :thumbsup:

matt: +1 :thumbsup:

keisha: +1 :thumbsup:
